rater: Software developer, 3 years' experience (one rater, not Directorate data)

causes.name: Slow external service, outbound call has no timeout
causes.description: A request waits on a slow external service with no time limit, so threads pile up and pages stall or fail
causes.remedy: Set a timeout on the outbound call

causes.name: Long-running transaction holds row locks
causes.description: A background job or long transaction keeps rows locked, so other writes wait and then fail

causes.name: Missing index on a growing table
causes.description: A frequent query scans a whole table that has grown large, so one operation becomes slow

causes.name: Repeated queries per request (N+1) on a heavy endpoint
causes.description: One request runs a query per item, using heavy CPU and slowing the endpoint

causes.name: Cache failing silently, every request recomputes
causes.description: Cache reads or writes fail with only a warning, so every request falls back to the slow path

causes.name: Bad release or migration breaks a code path
causes.description: A recent release or schema change breaks behaviour that used to work

causes.name: Duplicate rows where one was expected
causes.description: Duplicate records make a single-row lookup throw an error, usually for particular records

causes.name: Sign-in writes collide on the user row
causes.description: Concurrent sign-in and token writes update the same user row and fail on lock conflicts
causes.remedy: Move the token write off the sign-in path

checks.name: Long outbound span in traces
checks.tests: Whether requests are spending their time waiting on another service

checks.name: Lock-wait errors in logs
checks.tests: Whether database writes are failing while waiting for locks

checks.name: DB connection pool usage
checks.tests: Whether the application is running short of database connections

checks.name: API node CPU
checks.tests: Whether the application nodes are short of CPU

checks.name: Long transaction in the DB
checks.tests: Whether a database transaction has been open for an unusually long time

checks.name: Query plan of slowest query
checks.tests: Whether the slowest query is reading a whole table

checks.name: Query count in a slow trace
checks.tests: Whether one request is running an unusually large number of queries

checks.name: Cache errors in logs
checks.tests: Whether cache reads or writes are failing

checks.name: Recent release or migration
checks.tests: Whether something changed shortly before the incident

checks.name: Failure scope
checks.tests: Whether the failure affects everyone or only some records or users
checks.positive_means: Only specific records or users affected

checks.name: Full log analysis (delegated)
checks.tests: Whether a full analysis of the logs and stack traces traces the failure to a specific place in the application's own code
checks.positive_means: The analysis names a file or function in the application's code where the failure starts

symptoms.name: Users see a server error on a page
Pages very slow or timing out
Users can't sign in or get logged out
A save or approval fails after a long wait
symptoms.reported_as: Spins about a minute, then errors

rules.reason: Killing the wrong transaction rolls back valid work
A rollback restarts every node, and migrations may not reverse
Other records may depend on the rows, and deletes are hard to undo
Index builds on large tables can block live traffic
A wrong timeout can make failures look like real results
